description: This file defines a React functional component named ReportsPage used to provide a user interface for generating and exporting PDF reports within a timesheet or project tracking frontend. It includes state management for form inputs, handles report export via an API call, and manages UI feedback such as loading state and error display.

methods.name: ReportsPage()
methods.description: React functional component rendering the report export interface, managing user input for date range and handling report export logic.

methods.name: onExport
methods.description: Asynchronous function handling the export process: calls the API, processes response, and manages window opening or error setting.
